input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only the Customer with a 24-month no-hire covering every Vendor employee, with no carve-out for general advertising or unsolicited applicants ("regardless of how the employee applies"). That is a no-hire provision at the walk-away edge of our playbook and it contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment. Preferred position is no non-solicit on Customer, so we delete the clause; fallback (mutual, 12 months, personnel directly involved, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) is offered in the comment.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the one-way 24-month no-hire in § 12.4: our playbook does not accept hiring restrictions on the Customer, and this clause directly contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and remain free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. If Vendor needs protection, we can accept a mutual non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire element.
proposal.summary: Delete the one-way 24-month no-hire/non-solicit imposed on Customer in § 12.4.
